fieldDescription: A few seconds after a new game starts, a message offers to open the Rule Book. You can open it at any time from the Rule Book entry under Personal on the intel screen.
Lets you pick every rule, also the ones you have not unlocked through achievements or challenges yet. Your real unlocks are kept and come back when you switch this off.
Positive rules cost points and negative rules give points. With this on, you cannot confirm a rule set that costs more than it gives.
